breakdowns.description: Reads analog sensor data from GPIO 34 at regular intervals.
conditions: Invalid readings must be handled (logged or ignored)

breakdowns.description: Generates a unique device_id and a private hash key at runtime using the ESP32 MAC address.
conditions: Device identity is derived from ESP32 MAC address
Key is stored in-memory only (no hardcoded secrets)
Key is generated at runtime during initialization

breakdowns.description: Signs sensor data using HMAC-SHA256 and assembles the telemetry payload.
conditions: Payload structure includes device_id, timestamp (epoch seconds), sensor_value (integer), and signature (hex encoded HMAC)

breakdowns.description: Transmits signed telemetry payload over HTTPS using WiFi in station mode.
conditions: Basic connection retry logic for error handling
